methods.method_family: request-level cost accounting and causal attribution
methods.cost: Requires end-to-end identifiers, sampled telemetry and baseline instrumentation.
methods.risk: Measurement overhead and feedback attribution errors.

methods.method_family: replay of real playback, CDN and object traces
methods.cost: Requires representative client, network and content traces.
methods.risk: Offline replay misses user adaptation and regional provider behavior.

methods.method_family: dual-timescale profile state with provenance and revocation tests
methods.cost: Adds version, dependency and deletion metadata.
methods.risk: Overly strict projection can reduce recommendation coverage.

methods.method_family: state ownership plus fault injection and capacity modeling
methods.cost: Requires representative topology and failure tests.
methods.risk: Premature distributed complexity without proven scale.

target_objectives: 低源站/客户端/集群网络字节
满意度、卡顿、覆盖和授权硬约束
可扩容、故障恢复和可接受单位成本
tradeoff_styles: 不预设权重的帕累托比较
先做同 trace 基线与消融，再做线上灰度
对隐私与用户体验使用门槛约束，不与成本线性抵消
按设备、网络、内容类型、活跃度和内容长尾分层
selection_notes: 本轮只选择 request-joint-cost 作为枢轴问题求解；其余方法保留为依赖条件，不给出全局排名。
method_families: HMM 状态/约束/IFR 与 EAFC
一手研究检索与证据分级
请求级性能剖析和分布式 trace 回放
多目标帕累托与非劣门槛
故障注入与数据治理验证
applicable_constraints: 候选、媒体与画像均需可追溯
excluded_methods: 没有 trace 的臆造容量规划
以单个论文 uplift 直接设定系统验收值
先选厂商产品再倒推需求
把执行排期伪装成问题分解
fallback_weight_method: 若用户后续提供明确优先级则按用户权重；否则保持非支配集合，不做 AHP 或伪精确总分。
